data.name: Ramchandar
data.gender_notes: Ramchandar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram means 'God' and Chandra means 'Moon'. Ramchandar is the name of the deity Rama who is considered the seventh avatar of the god Vishnu. The name Ramchandar carries the meaning “God of Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramchandar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramchandar represents the divine power of love, courage, and devotion. He is the embodiment of the ideal husband, brother, and friend. His name inspires devotion, selflessness, and inner strength.
data.etymology: Ramchandar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Rama.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramchandar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Ramchandar is a revered name in Hindu culture, associated with the popular epics Ramayana and Mahabharata. The Ramayana narrates the life story of Lord Rama, an embodiment of righteousness and duty, whose story continues to inspire millions of Hindus through the ages. The name Ramchandar is therefore deeply engrained in Hindu spirituality and mythology, evoking a sense of reverence and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: Ramchandar represents the divine embodiment of moral values, duty, and righteousness, making it a spiritually significant name in Hinduism. Lord Rama is considered an ideal character whose life exemplifies ahimsa (non-violence), truth, selflessness, forgiveness, and devotion to duty and family. The name Ramchandar is a reminder of these values and serves as a source of inspiration for those who seek to embody them in their own lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramchandar symbolizes the embodiment of God Rama, signifying strength, righteousness, and devotion. The name is a reminder to live in harmony with the divine principles of love, truth, and selflessness.
